chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0391 – Ji Ning's Dao-Heart Trial & the Luohu Bow
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces the most dangerous trial yet: an illusion that tests his deepest emotions. Can he let go of the memory of his parents to claim the ancient Luohu Bow?
og_title: The Warmth of Illusion and the Weight of a Bow
og_description: Ji Ning shatters a Dao-heart illusion that traps him in his childhood home. In exchange, he earns a top-grade innate spirit treasure: the Luohu Bow.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Walks Through Illusions of Family
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s toughest trial isn’t a monster or a formation—it’s the memory of his parents. He breaks free and claims the legendary Luohu Bow.

lore_anchors.definition: A Fiendgod Divine Ability that allows the cultivator to manifest extra limbs, multiplying their combat effectiveness in close-quarters battle.

In Xianxia cultivation, the Dao-heart represents a cultivator's unwavering will, emotional resilience, and clarity of purpose. A firm Dao-heart is essential for resisting inner demons and passing tribulations.

A treasure born from the primordial forces of Heaven and Earth, possessing its own spiritual nature. Unlike refined treasures, it can choose its own master and is extremely difficult to forcibly refine.
A top-grade innate spirit treasure forged from the corpse of the ancient terror Luohu. It is one of the ten great divine bows of the Primordial Pangu World.
The legendary archer who shot down nine of the ten suns. In Desolate Era, his archery art is one of the most difficult trials in the Three Realms Palace.
The original universe created by the god Pangu, which later shattered and was reorganized into the Three Realms.
Ancient, primordial beings born from chaos. They possess terrifying physical power and are often the source of the most powerful divine abilities and treasures.
